title: Bubble Sorceress
description: A woman with short black hair in a pink and black Renaissance-style dress kneels on stone pavement, reaching toward the ground as she releases translucent soap bubbles. She is positioned before a large gothic cathedral with green and pink striped stonework on the left and a vibrant wall of floating orange and red glowing rectangular panels on the right.
prompt: A woman with short black bob hair wearing a vibrant pink Renaissance dress with black corset and gold details kneels on ornate stone pavement in front of a towering gothic cathedral with green and pink striped masonry. She reaches toward the ground releasing dozens of large transparent soap bubbles that float around her. To the right is a surreal wall of glowing orange and red floating rectangular panels against a teal background, dramatic cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting
